$description: Generated by tools/build-tokens.mjs from docs/tokens.json (Tessel revision 3). Do not edit.

elevation.scope: Floating layers sit on raised or selected fills, a 1px edge and a shadow. Shadows never replace the edge.

popup.use: Menus, dropdowns, combo lists, context menus

focusRing.scope: Every focusable element shows one thin outline in the focus role (Carmine in the dark theme). Rows and tabs use the inset ring so it is never clipped by a neighbor.
focusRing.rule: Keep the ring visible against both the control and its parent surface. On the selected fill the ring and the selection marker must both stay visible.

table.scope: Dense tables and data lists. Extends the data list rules.
table.numeric: Right-aligned, tabular figures, header aligned with the column
table.rule: A sorted column shows its arrow in the header and its sort in the accessible name. No row stripes: gridlines carry rows.

breadcrumb.collapse: Middle items collapse into an overflow menu; the first and last two stay visible

statusBar.rule: Near-black bar (the surround role). Left to right in the listed order. State that changes with the document sits left; app-wide state sits right. Every segment with an action is a button with a visible focus ring and a tooltip. Text uses the dense size in the muted role, with a small Carmine indicator beside the workspace state.

indicator.form: Small Carmine square beside the workspace-state segment, always paired with its text label

loading.indicator: Ten-segment determinate progress when the total is known, moving segment when unknown

empty.grid: The fine square grid shows in the empty area and fades behind the block
empty.rule: Name what is missing and the one action that fixes it.

error.rule: Error text uses the danger role with an icon and a label. Keep the failed input and the user data on screen.

offline.rule: Keep read-only content usable. Disable only the actions that need the network and say which.

commandPalette.scope: Extends shortcuts.palette. The palette lists everything the product can do and teaches its shortcuts.

registry.labelRule: Verb first, sentence case, 2 to 5 words, no trailing punctuation
registry.idRule: Stable dotted id such as file.save. Ids never change between releases
registry.coverage: Every command reachable from a menu, toolbar or shortcut is in the palette. A missing command is a defect

rows.disabledStyle: Muted label plus the reason in text. Never hide a disabled command
rows.highlight: Bold matching letters, never color alone

keys.secondary: Ctrl+Enter shows where the command lives in the menus

accessibility.pattern: Modal dialog containing a combobox and a listbox
accessibility.announce: Result count after the user pauses typing
accessibility.focusReturn: To the element that opened the palette

layouts.scope: Saved arrangements, docking and multi-window rules. Extends workspace.modes and workspace.panels.

focus.regions: Dominant region and status bar. Panels collapse to the edge

review.regions: Dominant region and one side panel at 25 to 35%

wide.regions: Navigation 15 to 20%, dominant region, detail 20 to 35%. The default

presets.rule: Every preset is also a palette command. Users can save their own and name them.

docking.keyboardMove: Alt+Arrow moves the focused panel to the next dock slot in that direction
docking.reset: Restores the current preset and keeps all data and settings

detach.windowRule: A detached window has its own title, status bar and one active-region rule
detach.missingMonitor: The window returns to the primary monitor, fully on screen

density.rule: Density changes per view or window, never inside one data list

multiView.linkedSelection: Optional, shown with a labeled toggle, off by default
multiView.activeView: One active view per window. It shows the active-region rule and owns the keyboard

canvas.scope: Infinite and large canvases: whiteboards, node editors, CAD sheets, maps, timelines. Chrome stays flat and fixed; only content moves.

zoom.wheel: Ctrl+Wheel zooms around the pointer. Plain wheel pans

pan.pointer: Space+drag, middle-button drag or the Pan tool
pan.bounds: None. Home returns to the content

grid.scope: Same 24 px cell as the signature grid

minimap.textAlternative: Viewport position and share of the canvas as text

move.snapStep: Shift moves by the snap size

accessibility.objectList: A panel lists every object in reading order and is navigable with Tab and the arrow keys
accessibility.announce: Selection, moves and zoom changes are announced as text
accessibility.textFloor: Labels scale with the content but never render below the caption size on screen

chrome.rule: Toolbars, panels, rulers and the status bar stay flat and fixed. The viewport may use depth and its own palette.

undo.scope: Reversible actions beat confirmation dialogs. Extends shortcuts.required undo and redo and feedback.toast.

stack.coalesce: Typing and slider drags merge into one entry per pause

history.jump: Selecting an entry jumps to that state. Later entries stay as redo until a new action

toast.keyboard: The shortcut works while the toast shows, and the action is reachable with the region cycle key

irreversible.confirm: Name the target and the effect. The safe choice is the default. Cancel comes first

autosave.rule: Drafts save silently. Say Saved only after a manual save or when saving fails

inlineFeedback.scope: Quiet feedback beside the thing that changed. Extends feedback.placement.

validation.timing: On blur, then on every change once a field shows an error
validation.association: aria-describedby on the field and aria-invalid when invalid
validation.onSubmit: A status region states the count, focus moves to the first invalid field

success.inline: Confirm in place with text such as Saved, beside the control or in the status bar

quiet.meaning: Ambient means always available and quiet, not animated. Use status text, counts and badges

optimistic.rule: Show the result at once, label it Syncing in text, and on failure roll back with an inline message and an Undo or Retry action

neverOverride: text-field editing keys (copy, cut, paste, arrows, Home, End)

placement.panel: banner at the top of the affected panel
placement.blocking: modal dialog only when work cannot continue

confirmation.buttons: verb labels that name the action
